quests.title: Seven a.m. At Penrith Plaza
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The site at Penrith Plaza starts its jackhammer at nine sharp on a Melbourne Cup day, which is illegal and loud. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Photograph it running and have a word with the Penrith foreman. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the noise from Penrith Plaza
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Counting Tench Reserve
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Council says the Tench Reserve car park is never full and I say it's full by school pick-up. I am aware how that sounds. Count both Penrith car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: count the cars at Tench Reserve
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: Before They Touch High Street
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They start on High Street on Saturday and the orange fencing goes up. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. I want Penrith on record before it does. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: photograph the state of High Street
then the other end of it

quests.title: Rent Money, the Penrith Whitewater stadium
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I'm forty-five short on the the Penrith Whitewater stadium rent and the agent doesn't take stories. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Make it somewhere in Penrith by first thing; I'm not fussy how. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Penrith

quests.title: Trouble at Mulgoa Road
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Two lads and their mate decided at eleven that Mulgoa Road is theirs. This is the third time I have had this conversation. The rest of Penrith disagrees, so explain the disagreement. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: sort the pair near Mulgoa Road
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: Probationary at Mulgoa Road
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. A young constable has been doing his first solo patrol round Mulgoa Road since Thursday. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. He's decided Penrith is his, so give him a story for the sergeant. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: lose the probationary constable near Mulgoa Road

quests.title: The the Log Cabin Course
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. A bloke near the Log Cabin runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Sit it Anzac Day, then come back to Penrith and prove it did something. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: do the course they run near the Log Cabin
then show me what it taught you

quests.title: One Stop From Penrith Paceway
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I need to know the train from Penrith stops at Blacktown and doesn't sail through like it did on the last Sunday of the month. It started small, the way these things do. Ride it at six in the morning and photograph the sign. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: take the train to Blacktown
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: Cover at the Great Western Highway
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I've got nobody for the the Great Western Highway shift at eight at night and a room full of Penrith people who've paid. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Staffy Near the Nepean River
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at the Nepean River at first thing. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Everyone in Penrith has definitely seen it and can't say where. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near the Nepean River
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: Closing Time at the Nepean River
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on the Nepean River since the pub shut. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. The Penrith delivery's at closing, so get them up and show me the step empty. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off the Nepean River
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: Something From High Street
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The stall at High Street has run out and the customers keep coming. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Find something round Penrith that'll do before the half seven rush. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: pick something up near High Street
bring it to the stall

quests.title: Ask Around at Blacktown
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. There's work going outside Blacktown station and nobody at Mulgoa Road can tell me what. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Ride over at ten past ten, get the shape of it, come back. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: take the train to Blacktown
find the people outside Blacktown station
then come back and tell me what they said

quests.title: The the Log Cabin Camera
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. A new speed camera near the Log Cabin has fined half of Penrith since Melbourne Cup day. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Blacktown is faster anyway. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Log Cabin
then take the train instead, to Blacktown

quests.title: A Flat White From Penrith Paceway
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I want a flat white from the place near Penrith Paceway, not the one next to it. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Here by the last train, while it's still coffee and Penrith still has some. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near Penrith Paceway
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: The Mulgoa Road Complaint
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside Mulgoa Road since Sunday. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. One has Penrith council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near Mulgoa Road

quests.title: Proof of the Great Western Highway
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Nobody in Penrith believes what the Great Western Highway looks like at the change of shift. It started small, the way these things do. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: get a picture of the Great Western Highway before they fix it

quests.title: Before They Touch the Panthers
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. They start on the Panthers on Sunday and the orange fencing goes up. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I want Penrith on record before it does. That's it. That's the whole ask.

then the other end of it
